SELECT AVG(sa.score) FROM studentAssessment sa JOIN assessments a ON sa.id_assessment = a.id_assessment JOIN studentInfo si ON sa.id_student = si.id_student AND a.code_module = si.code_module AND a.code_presentation = si.code_presentation WHERE si.code_module = 'CCC' AND si.final_result = 'Distinction' AND a.assessment_type = 'TMA'
